faqs.question: My child already drinks milk. Do they still need this?
faqs.answer:
A glass of milk gives roughly
300mg of calcium. Teens need ~1000mg daily. Unless your teen is drinking 4 glasses of milk
a day (and absorbing all of it), the gap is real.

faqs.question: Is this safe for both boys and girls aged 13–18?
faqs.answer:
Yes. The formulation is suitable for
all teens in the 13–18 age group, regardless of gender.

faqs.question: Can my teen take this along with their multivitamins?
faqs.answer:
Yes, these gummies are
designed to complement a balanced diet and other supplements. If your teen is already on
prescribed medication, consult your doctor.

faqs.question: Will this cause any side effects?
faqs.answer:
No known side effects. The chicory root prebiotic
base actually supports better digestion. If any reactions occur, stop use and consult a doctor.

faqs.question: How is this different from the kids' calcium gummies?
faqs.answer:
The 13+ formulation has a
higher calcium dosage and includes B12, aligned with teen-specific nutritional needs, which
are significantly higher than those of younger children. The Mom's formulation is the closest
match for this age group.

faqs.question: My teen hates tablets, will they actually take this?
faqs.answer:
That's exactly why it's a gummy.
No chalk, no bitterness, no water needed. Strawberry flavour. Most teens self-administer without reminders once they start.

reviews.author: Priya Menon
reviews.title: Strong Bones Win
reviews.body: My 14 year old son plays football 5 days a week. His coach actually told us to focus on calcium before he turns 16. Came across these, the fact that they’re vegan and no added sugar made it easy to say yes. He takes them himself without me reminding him that’s the real win

reviews.author: Rekha Kandil
reviews.title: Worry to Relief
reviews.body: My daughter is 16 and barely drinks milk. I was genuinely worried about her bone health given how much she dances. These are easy, she likes the taste, and I feel like I’m actually doing something about the gap in her diet

reviews.author: Shekar Gulal
reviews.title: Actually Works
reviews.body: Honestly was skeptical calcium gummies sounded too good to be true. But the D3 + calcium combo makes scientific sense, our pediatrician also confirmed it. My 13 year old son has been taking these for 6 weeks now. No complaints from him which is saying a lot.

reviews.author: Deepa Krishnamurthy
reviews.title: Happy With It
reviews.body: My teen daughter has been on these for 2 months. She’s also started asking questions about what she eats which was unexpected. Small thing but I think when kids understand why they’re taking something, they own it. The packaging explains it well enough for a teenager to get it

reviews.author: Sunita Agarwal
reviews.title: Right Choice
reviews.body: We are pure vegetarian and finding a vegan D3 source was important to us. Most supplements use animal-based D3. Little Joys uses Lichen my husband actually verified this before we ordered. My 15 year old takes 2 every morning with breakfast. Happy with the purchase.
